observations: Photo 0 shows the rear/side of a black Xbox One console with a visible power/vent area; no power adapter shown.
Photo 1 shows the front/top of the console with a single Xbox-style controller placed on top; no games/discs/cases shown.
No clear model/version (Xbox One / One S / One X) label is readable in the photos.
No visible evidence of the stated adaptor issue (no adapter, no port close-up, no power-on screen).

claims.claim: Xbox one with one pad for sell
claims.evidence: Photo 1 shows one controller on top, but it does not prove it is included/working or that it is the only pad.
No game discs/cases or screenshots are shown in the photos.
Photos show the console but do not show the adapter, the power port, or any power-on test.

risks.risk: Console may not power on / may have a power supply or port fault (adapter issue could be more than just the adapter).
risks.proof: A short video clip of plugging in the adapter, pressing power, and showing the Xbox boot screen (or no-boot behavior) plus a close-up of the power input port.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully working / power issue (worst case), using the cheapest matching comparable.

risks.risk: Controller may have drift/buttons faults or may not be the one included.
risks.proof: A clip showing controller connected and working in the Xbox menu (button test / moving cursor).
risks.if_unproven: Price as controller unverified (worst case: treat as basic/possibly faulty).

risks.risk: Games may be missing, not the ones claimed, or may require accounts/are not playable.
risks.proof: Photos of the 6 game cases/discs (or a screenshot of installed games list).
risks.if_unproven: Price as no games included (worst case).

risks.risk: Exact Xbox One model/version (One / One S / One X) affects value; photos don’t show readable model label.
risks.proof: Photo of the console label/model number from the underside/back (where it’s printed).
risks.if_unproven: Price as the lowest-value Xbox One variant.

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the console model label (underside/back) showing the exact Xbox One version.
Send a short video: connect power adapter, press power, and show the boot screen (or confirm it fails).
Send a close-up photo of the power input port and the adapter/charger itself (showing the exact adapter included).
Send photos of the 6 games (cases/discs) or a screenshot of the installed games list.
Send a clip showing the controller working (cursor movement/button response in the Xbox menu).
response.reason: The photos confirm an Xbox One console and a controller are present, but they do not verify the adaptor issue, the exact Xbox One model, or the claimed 6 games—so a worst-case price cannot be set confidently from the provided evidence.
